subject: URGENT: Production latency & 504s impacting Zenith - path investigation
messages:
From: Anna Lowe <anna@zenithretail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Zenith NOC <noc@zenithretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T08:12:00-05:00
Subject: Production latency & 504s - affecting checkout flows

Hi Evelyn,

We're seeing a spike in latency and 504s hitting Redwood-powered tokenization and completion endpoints in production starting ~06:00 PST. Impact summary: p95 latency ~2.1s (normal 600ms), error rate ~3.8% (504/timeouts), throughput degraded by ~20% for our peak shards. This is causing checkout slowdowns for 15% of requests and elevated cart abandonment.

We've captured application traces and some tcpdump snippets (attached as traces.tar.gz). Early signs point to transient connection resets between our VPC and Redwood's egress cluster. Our NOC also saw intermittent DNS NXDOMAINs for redwood-edge-us-west.redwood.ai around the same window.

Can you please triage and advise next steps? We need ETA on mitigation and whether you can fail traffic to another region while you investigate.

Thanks,
Anna Lowe
Director of Infrastructure
Zenith Retail

Attachment: traces.tar.gz (application traces, tcpdump excerpts)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lowe <anna@zenithretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Zenith NOC <noc@zenithretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T08:25:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Production latency & 504s - affecting checkout flows

Anna, thanks for the quick flag and for attaching the traces — we see the same spike on our side. I'm escalating to SRE immediately and looping in Sergio from account engineering.

Quick asks while we dig in:
- Can you send a raw traceroute (ICMP and TCP to port 443) from one of the affected app nodes to edge-us-west.redwood.ai?
- If possible, a short packet capture spanning a failed request (single 30–60s capture) would help.

We will attempt an emergency failover of Zenith's routing to an alternate egress pool (us-west-1) if our initial checks indicate path-level issues. I'll update in 20–30 minutes with next steps.

Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 (415) 555-0137

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Anna Lowe <anna@zenithretail.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Zenith NOC <noc@zenithretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:03:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Production latency & 504s - affecting checkout flows

Folks, I've pulled the traces and the pcap Anna included. Quick summary of what I'm seeing:

1) Path-level retransmits and RSTs between Zenith's VPC (10.34.0.0/16) and our us-west-2 egress pool. Multiple flows show bursts of retransmits right before the 504s.
2) Traceroutes indicate an asymmetry: packets from Zenith to our egress traverse a transit gateway + managed firewall in their account; return traffic is routed via a different transit edge (likely provider-side). That mismatch correlates with packet reordering and drops.
3) DNS: there are sporadic SERVFAIL/NXDOMAIN responses to edge-us-west.redwood.ai coming from Zenith's recursive resolvers during the window; these line up with the same timestamps.

Immediate mitigation plan (requires your approval, Evelyn / Anna):
- Shift Zenith's routing to our alternate egress pool in us-west-1 (will take ~6 mins to activate for active connections; soft-fail for in-flight connections).
- Reduce max-batch size for Zenith's tokenization route to lower concurrent stream counts while we stabilize.
- Increase TCP keepalive and lower idle timeouts for affected endpoints to reduce mid-path teardown impact.

I've attached extracted traceroute output and a CSV of DNS query timestamps that show the SERVFAIL cluster for your NOC. If we don't see improvement within 15 minutes of failover, next step is partnering with Zenith's network team to work through the transit gateway/firewall config (their side).

Attachments: zenith_traceroute-20261118.txt, dns-queries-20261118.csv

--
Rishi Malhotra
SRE, Redwood Inference
Pager: +1 (888) 555-0101 (pager)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Executive note — Zenith production impact and customer comms

Evelyn / Rishi,

Thanks for the rapid response and the proposed mitigations. Please proceed with the us-west-1 failover and batch-size reduction now; prioritize restoring 95th percentile latency under 1s and reducing errors below 0.5%.

A few executive items:
- Approve up to one day of pro-rated service credit for Zenith should the incident exceed our internal SLO once root cause is confirmed. Finance, please flag if that requires additional sign-off.
- Prepare a short customer-facing incident summary (one page) with: timeline, impact, mitigation, and next steps. Evelyn, coordinate with Sergio on technical details.
- Post-incident: schedule a joint RCA call with Zenith's network team and our NetOps to resolve the transit/firewall asymmetry.

Anna, I will join the RCA call and can escalate to our COO if there are contractual SLA questions. Keep me posted on the 15-minute window after failover.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Reliability & Escalations
Redwood Inference
